resolution: Set both ends to auto-negotiate; duplex now full on both sides

title: Users cannot connect to corporate Wi-Fi
description: Users cannot connect to corporate Wi-Fi, authentication failing
root_cause: Shared secret mismatch after the controller was replaced
resolution: Re-entered the correct shared secret on the controller

title: Uplink interface Te0/0/0 went down
description: Uplink interface Te0/0/0 went down, no carrier detected
root_cause: Faulty SFP transceiver on Te0/0/0
resolution: ISP team spliced the damaged fiber; link restored after 3 hours

title: Users cannot open websites but can ping IP addresses
description: Users cannot open websites but can ping IP addresses
root_cause: Firewall rule change blocked UDP 53 to the DNS server
resolution: Restored the firewall rule allowing DNS traffic

title: Applications failing with name resolution errors
description: Applications failing with name resolution errors
root_cause: Firewall rule change blocked UDP 53 to the DNS server
resolution: Restored the firewall rule allowing DNS traffic

title: Users cannot connect after joining Wi-Fi
description: Users cannot connect after joining Wi-Fi, no IP lease
root_cause: Scope too small after more users moved to the floor
resolution: Expanded the scope from /24 to /23

title: Interface Gi0/1 shut down by port security violation
description: Interface Gi0/1 shut down by port security violation
root_cause: BPDU received on a portfast port from a small switch
resolution: Removed the rogue switch and re-enabled the port

title: Firewall session table full
description: Firewall session table full, new connections dropped
root_cause: Malware-infected host opening thousands of connections
resolution: Isolated the infected host and cleared its sessions

title: Whole floor lost network
description: Whole floor lost network, MAC address table flapping
root_cause: BPDU guard disabled on access ports after a template change
resolution: Restored the access port template with BPDU guard and storm control

title: Memory utilisation alarm
description: Memory utilisation alarm, process consuming more memory every day
root_cause: Known memory leak bug in the current firmware version
resolution: Upgraded the firmware to the fixed release in a maintenance window

title: Intermittent packet loss to servers behind Te0/0/0
description: Intermittent packet loss to servers behind Te0/0/0
root_cause: Damaged copper cable between switch and patch panel
resolution: Replaced the Cat6 cable; CRC counters stopped increasing

title: DHCP scope for the guest VLAN at 100% utilisation
description: DHCP scope for the guest VLAN at 100% utilisation
root_cause: DHCP lease time too long for a high-churn guest network
resolution: Reduced the lease time to 4 hours and cleared stale leases

title: Device crashed with out-of-memory after a long uptime
description: Device crashed with out-of-memory after a long uptime
root_cause: Logging process leaking memory when the syslog server is unreachable
resolution: Restored syslog server reachability and restarted the logging process

title: Loss of signal alarm on Gi0/0/1
description: Loss of signal alarm on Gi0/0/1, branch office offline
root_cause: Fiber cable cut during civil work near the site
resolution: Replaced the SFP module on Gi0/0/1; link came up and traffic restored
